top_signals.title: Stocks Churn as Consumer Worries Offset Tech Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: The final stretch of a jittery week on Wall Street saw stocks wavering after weak consumer sentiment data underscored concerns about inflationary pressures amid still-elevated energy costs.
